title: Google Ads + SEO + AI Web Specialist — AU Agency, Trades Niche
description:
ABOUT BUILD UP FLOW



Build Up Flow (BUF) is an Australian growth agency working with trades, construction, and design businesses. Right now we're focused on the AU market — as we grow, we're expanding into the US and other English-speaking markets.



We're not a one-service vendor — we're an integrated growth partner running paid ads, recruitment, and systems for clients who care about pipeline, not impressions.



We move fast. We're direct. If you like fluff or hide behind reports, this isn't your seat.



THE ROLE



You'll own everything Google for BUF clients: Google Ads, SEO, and the websites the SEO actually lives on. Most of our clients need a proper foundation built — site + keywords + technical SEO + Search/PMax campaigns — then ongoing optimisation.



We don't want a traditional web developer. We want someone who uses AI to build sites fast and well — Lovable, v0, Bolt, Claude, GHL's AI builder, WordPress + AI plugins, whatever tool fits the job. If AI can build it in a day, that's the move. Your value is in knowing what to build, wiring SEO into the structure, and making it look and convert like a professional did it — not in writing custom code.



You'll use AI heavily across everything: keyword research, content briefs, on-page optimisation, schema, site builds, ad copy. We don't care which tools you use — we care that the output is sharp and the work moves fast.



This is a part-time role starting at around 10 hours/week across our current client load. We add new clients regularly, and your hours, pay, and account load grow with us. We want someone who treats BUF like their own agency, not a side gig.



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



- Build and manage Google Ads campaigns — Search, Performance Max, Display, retargeting

- Full-stack SEO: keyword research, on-page, technical, content briefs, internal linking, schema

- Use AI to build and iterate on client websites fast (Lovable, v0, GHL AI builder, WordPress + AI, or whatever fits) — SEO baked in from the structure up, not bolted on

- Use AI daily across keyword research, content generation, site copy, and on-page optimisation

- Map keyword clusters to site architecture and content plans

- Set up tracking properly — GA4, GTM, conversion tracking, call tracking

- Document your process and updates in Notion (our whole knowledge base lives there)

- Weekly reporting on Google Ads performance and SEO movement with a clear point of view

- Communicate directly with the BUF team via Slack / Loom / call



MUST-HAVES



- 3+ years managing Google Ads (Search + PMax minimum)

- Strong SEO knowledge — technical, on-page, and content

- Proven track record managing AU, US, or UK client accounts

- Proven ability to build professional websites using AI tools — show us sites you've shipped using Lovable, v0, Bolt, GHL, WordPress + AI, or similar

- Strong taste — you can spot AI-slop and produce output that looks like a designer built it

- GoHighLevel — comfortable building sites and funnels inside it

- Notion — comfortable working inside it daily for SOPs, tracking, and documentation

- AI tools — Claude (web + Projects), Claude Code, ChatGPT used daily for real work, not novelty

- Strong English written communication

- Reliable internet + ability to overlap with Australian business hours (AEST)

- You can read a dashboard and form an opinion, not just describe what you see



BONUS



- Experience with trades, home services, solar, or construction clients

- Local SEO and Google Business Profile optimisation experience

- Familiar with n8n or other automation tools

- Familiar with multiple AI site builders and knows when to use which

- Has built or contributed to a GHL website template/snapshot

- Good English speaking skills



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with the word "GROW" so we know you read this.



Send:

1. A short paragraph on a Google Ads result you're proud of (numbers — spend, CPL, conversion rate)

2. A site you've built using AI tools — link it, tell us which tools you used

3. One ranking improvement you've driven (keyword, position movement, timeframe)

4. The AI tools you use weekly and one specific way you use them in SEO or web builds

5. Your rate and weekly availability



Applications without the keyword get deleted.

title: YouTube Video Editor for Premium Finance Channel
description:
I’m looking for a skilled YouTube video editor for an ongoing long-form YouTube channel in the finance, wealth-building and trading space.



The channel covers personal finance, wealth building, financial independence, investing, property, business lessons, money psychology, and occasionally trading / financial markets.



The editing style I want is clean, premium, intelligent and retention-focused.



I do NOT want childish editing, random effects, crypto-style hype, neon graphics, 
 edits, loud transitions, or TikTok-style chaos.



Think more:

- premium personal finance YouTube editing

- clean talking-head pacing

- clear text overlays

- simple charts and numbers

- tasteful B-roll

- clean jump cuts

- subtle motion graphics

- strong retention without cheap gimmicks

- finance/business content that feels calm, credible and high-quality



Typical videos will be around 8–12 minutes.



I will provide:

- talking-head footage

- script

- rough direction

- example videos I like

- brand/style references



You should be able to:

1. Remove dead space and tighten pacing

2. Add clean text overlays

3. Add simple charts, numbers, and financial examples

4. Use tasteful B-roll where needed

5. Add subtle music and sound design

6. Make financial ideas easy to understand visually

7. Keep the video feeling premium, calm, credible, and intelligent

8. Understand when a section needs a visual, chart, text overlay or pacing change



YouTube awareness is very important.



I do not just want someone who cuts clips together. I want someone who understands what makes YouTube videos work: pacing, retention, curiosity, clarity, hooks, titles, thumbnails, and viewer attention.



Thumbnail design experience is a strong bonus, but not required. We may hire a separate thumbnail designer if needed.



If you are excellent at video editing but prefer not to do thumbnails, that is perfectly fine. Please just make that clear in your application. I will still fully consider you for the role.



However, if you can create thumbnails, improve thumbnail concepts, or explain what makes a thumbnail clickable, that is a big advantage.



Some videos may also be about trading and financial markets, so experience editing trading, investing, finance, business, education, or chart-based content is also a strong bonus.



The first step will be a paid 60–90 second test edit. If that goes well, I’m looking for someone long-term, ideally for weekly / bi-weekly videos.



For the right person, there is plenty of ongoing work available. I care more about quality, reliability, communication, and YouTube understanding than finding the cheapest editor.



To apply, please include:



1. The word “WEALTH” at the top of your reply

2. Your best 3 examples of long-form YouTube editing

3. Any finance, business, investing, trading, education, or talking-head videos you have edited

4. Whether you do thumbnail design or prefer editing only

5. Any YouTube thumbnails you have designed, if applicable

6. Your hourly rate

7. Your usual turnaround time for an 8–12 minute YouTube video

8. What software you edit with

9. A short sentence explaining what makes a YouTube video hold attention

10. A short sentence explaining what makes a thumbnail clickable

11. A short sentence explaining how you would make a finance/trading video feel premium and easy to understand



Please do not send a copy-paste application. I will only read applications that follow the instructions above.



If your work is good, this can become regular weekly work.

title: Part-Time Web/App Designer for KR/JP Projects (Flexible Hours)
description:
Hello. This is Jayden Kim from Flash Studio.

Flash Studio is a development studio working on a variety of web and app outsourced projects for clients in Korea and Japan. We're looking for a Part-Time Web/App Designer to take charge of the design work for these projects.



Working hours are about 3~4 hours per day, with no fixed schedule.

As long as deadlines are met, you can work at night, early morning, or whenever works best for you.

The role is 100% remote, and we prefer long-term collaboration.



After 3 months from your start date, we will conduct a full-time conversion interview.

If you prefer to stay part-time, that's completely fine. You can continue working with us as a part-timer for as long as you'd like.



Responsibilities



- Website design for Korean and Japanese clients (landing pages, marketing sites, dashboards, SaaS, etc.)

- Mobile app UI design (iOS / Android)

- End-to-end design process from wireframes to high-fidelity mockups and prototypes

- Building and improving our design system and internal design workflow from the ground up

- Clean handoff to developers (specs, assets included)

- Fast iteration based on client and internal feedback



Requirements



- Portfolio with web and/or app design work that YOU personally designed

  * You must provide a live link (Behance, Dribbble, personal site, Notion, Figma, etc.) where we can review the work.

  * File attachments will NOT be reviewed. Link only.

- Proficiency in Figma and Adobe tools (Photoshop, Illustrator, etc.) for both high-quality UI design and Visual design

- Ability to propose logical solutions based on both quantitative and qualitative data

- Ability to build and scale a design system and operational workflow from the early stage

- Strong sense for modern web/app design with solid fundamentals (typography, layout, color)

- Experience with responsive design

- English communication sufficient for text-based asynchronous collaboration



What We Value Most



- Your willingness and drive to GROW is our #1 priority.

- Your design skills don't have to be perfect right now. You can learn and level up after joining.

- We care more about your mindset, logic, and growth potential than your current skill ceiling.



Nice to Have



- Experience building design systems

- Understanding of iOS HIG / Material Design

- Motion or micro-interaction experience

- Basic understanding of HTML/CSS

- Familiarity with Korean/Japanese or broader Asian design trends



Compensation & Benefits



- $4 ~ $8 USD per hour, based on experience and portfolio

- Paid as a flat amount for actual hours worked

- Unlimited support for any AI / productivity tools you need. Figma Make, ChatGPT, Claude and any other tool that helps you work better.

- After 3 months from your start date, we reimburse 100% of any self-development expenses (courses, books, conferences, learning subscriptions, etc.).

- Salary is formally renegotiated every 6 months. If you bring objective reasons for a raise, we will do our best to meet you there.



How to Apply



Step 1. Portfolio Submission

Please send your portfolio along with a short introduction and your background.

To show that you've read the post all the way through, please write "MOONLIGHT" at the top of your message.



Step 2. Paid Design Task

Shortlisted candidates will receive a short design task (about 1~2 hours of work).

Even if you are not selected after the task, we will pay you $20 USD for your time.



Step 3. Final Hire and Onboarding on the First Project



Please Note

- If you are not selected, we will not send a separate rejection notice. Thank you for your understanding.

title: Funnelish funnel builder
description:
Hey there,



We are looking for a new tea
mber to join our fast-growing 6-figure eCommerce business.



We run multiple online stores in the EU and are scaling fast. Because of this, we need to expand our team.



We are looking for someone responsible for one of the most important tasks in our business:

building complete, high-converting sales funnels.



You will turn products into full branded offers.



This includes:



- Product naming



- Logo creation



- Improving the copy



- Creating images that fit the copywriting



- Delivering a funnel that is ready to launch and convert



- This role requires speed, creativity, and attention to detail.



You will receive competitor funnels and ready-made templates as a base, which you will adapt, improve, and finalize into branded, high-converting funnels.



Meeting deadlines is extremely important.



We are looking for someone who is hardworking, smart, dedicated, detail-oriented, and able to work with minimal supervision.



Pay is excellent and this will become a full-time role with bonuses.



Please read the 4R model below for full details.



4R MODEL - FUNNEL BUILDER



ROLE



- You are responsible for building complete, branded sales funnels.



- You receive competitor funnels as inspiration and ready-made templates, then:



- Adapt them to our structure



- Improve and refine the copy where needed



- Create branding and visuals



- Deliver a polished, ready-to-launch funnel



Your work directly supports our testing and scaling process.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Analyze competitor funnels and use them as inspiration



- Adapt competitor structure and copy to fit our templates and brand style



- Improve copywriting where needed



- Create a unique brand name and logo for each product



- Create images that fit and support the copywriting



- Think of unique selling points and angles when needed



- Communicate proactively with the team and flag any blockers



- Meet agreed deadlines



- Track working hours using our time tracking tool



RESULTS



- Funnels that meet our quality standards and KPIs



- Funnels inspired by competitors but clearly improved and adapted



- Clean, professional branding that builds trust



- Clear, effective copy that supports conversions



- Consistent and reliable delivery



- Smooth collaboration with the team



REQUIREMENTS



- Experience with Funnelish or other page builder tools



- Basic graphic design skills such as logo creation and image editing



- Ability to analyze and adapt existing content



- Fluent in English



- Able to work independently with minimal supervision



- Organized, reliable, and deadline-driven



- Proactive communicator who asks questions when needed



- Plus: Previous experience in eCommerce or direct-response environments



WHAT WE OFFER



- Full-time position, Monday to Friday, weekends off



- Excellent hourly pay with performance-based raises



- Bonus system linked to KPIs



- Time tracking for accurate payment



- Long-term role with growth opportunities as we scale from 6 to 7-8 figures



- Clear SOPs, templates, and competitor examples



- Fast-paced environment with strong learning opportunities



Ready to grow with us?



If you are a fast learner, enjoy structured creative work, and want to be part of a growing eCommerce team, we want to hear from you.



Please send:



- Your resume



- Samples of your work



- A short cover letter explaining why you think you are a good fit

* Able to multitask across multiple clients and projects

* Calm and professional under pressure

title: Video & Static Performance Creative | META | AI + UGC | Part-time
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We are a fast-growing e-commerce brand in the fashion/footwear niche running paid ads on Meta 
 & Instagram). We are looking for a performance creative who can take our scripts and concepts and turn them into short-form video ads and static creatives that look real, feel native, and actually convert.



This is an execution-focused role. We handle the research, scripts, and strategy — your job is to bring it to life fast and clean. If you have instincts for what performs on Meta and want to contribute ideas, we welcome that too.



One thing is non-negotiable: the output must never look like AI. We want ads that feel authentic, human, and real — even when AI tools are used to produce them.





WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Edit short-form video ads (15–30 seconds) optimized for Meta (Reels/Stories format)

• Take a reference video we provide and swap out the product — keeping the structure, pacing and feel identical

• When we find a winning ad, create variations: different hooks, different opening scenes, different angles — same core concept

• Produce UGC-style content that feels genuine and human, not polished or corporate

• Use AI tools (Higgsfield, Sora, Kling, Runway or similar) in a way that the final output does NOT look AI-generated

• Create static ad creatives (single image, carousel) from provided briefs and assets

• Add text overlays, hooks, captions and voiceovers to videos

• Deliver clean, platform-ready files consistently and on time





YOU'RE A GREAT FIT IF YOU...

• Have hands-on experience editing short-form video ads for
 or Instagram

• Have experience with product swaps — taking an existing video and replacing the product seamlessly

• Know how to make AI-generated footage look real and human (this is a hard requirement — we will test this)

• Have worked with AI video tools such as Sora, Higgsfield, Kling, Runway or Pika

• Have created or edited UGC-style content before

• Know what makes a Meta ad perform: thumb-stop hooks, pacing, authentic feel, strong CTAs

• Are experienced with CapCut, Premiere Pro, or similar editing software

• Can take a brief and execute without needing constant back-and-forth

• Are reliable, fast, and consistent — deadlines matter





BONUS POINTS IF YOU...

• Have a portfolio showing UGC-style ads for fashion or lifestyle brands

• Can suggest hook or angle variations based on what you have seen perform on Meta

• Have experience scaling winning ads into test variations

• Have additional skills in graphic design, copywriting, or
 Ads





WHAT WE OFFER

• $4–$7 per hour based on experience and quality of work

• Part-time, long-term position with room to grow

• Scripts, reference videos and concepts provided — your job is to execute

• Direct communication with the founder

• Room to scale hours as the brand grows





HOW TO APPLY

Start your message with "SCALE READY" on the very first line — applications that do not start with this will not be considered.



Then include:



1. Two examples of Meta video ads you have edited or created — bonus if one is UGC-style

2. A short paragraph about which AI video tools you use and how you make the output look real, not AI-generated

3. Your available hours per week and your rate



One more thing: in 2–3 sentences, tell us what you would do if we gave you a winning video ad and asked you to make 3 variations of it. What would you change and why? Applicants who skip this will not move forward.

title: YouTube QUALITY CONTROL Reviewer — Trade Niche Channels (5-6 Videos/Day)
description:
**Title:** YouTube QUALITY CONTROL Reviewer — Trade Niche Channels (5-6 Videos/Day)



**Hours:** 15 Hours Per Week

**Pay:** $
/month USD depending on speed, accuracy, and niche knowledge

**Type:** Long-term, part-time, remote



---



I run a portfolio of faceless YouTube channels in trade niches, currently DIY woodworking and DIY plumbing, and I'm hiring a Quality Control Reviewer to catch issues in our daily uploads 



**A typical day:**



- Open the day's uploads (5-6 videos, 10-15 min each)

- Run through our QC checklist

- Watch the video at 1.5-2x while checking: script makes sense, visuals match what's being said, edits follow our SOP

- Write feedback per video (ONLY IF NECESSARY)

- Message the editor directly with anything that needs fixing

- Flag recurring issues so we can fix them upstream



**You're a strong fit if:**



- Your English is excellent — you can catch when a casual narrator is saying something that doesn't quite make sense

- You are obsessive about detail (this role will not work for anyone who skims)

- You have interest in or knowledge of woodworking AND/OR plumbing

THIS IS A LONG-TERM POSITION — not a one-off project. I’m looking for someone to work with me for at least 12 months, ideally years.

The style I need is fast-cut, native-feeling, trending-audio-driven — the kind of edit that looks like I made it myself on CapCut. Cinematic editing is NOT what I need (I have another editor for that). I need snappy, energetic, scroll-stopping cuts.



WHY THE TIMING MATTERS:

I’m travelling to Europe in approximately 4 weeks for an 8-week content trip. I will be filming across multiple European cities. I need you fully trained and producing at full capacity BEFORE I leave, so the content keeps flowing while I’m travelling. While I’m in Europe, our workflow will be: I film and upload during the European day, you edit overnight Philippine time, I wake up to finished edits in the morning Europe time, I approve and post.

THIS IS A REAL OPPORTUNITY. The Europe trip is a major growth push for my account. Whoever I hire will be a core part of that growth.



WHAT YOU WILL DO EACH WEEK:

• Receive a Google Drive folder of raw iPhone footage each day

• Sync trending audio (you stay on top of what’s hitting on TikTok)

title: Organic Sales Rep (Health & Supplements | Content + Execution | Performance-Based)
description:
We’re building an organic sales team to drive revenue for a health and supplements line through platforms like TikTok, X 
), and Reddit.



This is not a traditional social media role.

This is a performance-driven role focused on creating content, generating traffic, and converting attention into sales.

We provide proven hooks, angles, and direction—but we also expect you to contribute ideas, test variations, and help scale what works.



Important:

All content is targeted toward the US market, so understanding US tone, language, and audience behavior is critical.



What You’ll Do:

-Create 5–10 pieces of content daily across TikTok, X, Reddit, and other platforms

-Execute on provided hooks, scripts, and content frameworks

-Contribute your own ideas and variations

-Test different delivery styles, hooks, and messaging

-Drive traffic to our funnel (link-in-bio)

-Track views, clicks, and sales



Weekly Content Planning (Important):

-You will create a simple weekly content plan to stay aligned with brand direction.

-This is NOT a corporate content calendar.



It should include:

-Key angles/hooks you plan to test

-Content themes for the week (e.g., energy, wellness, lifestyle)

-Variations based on previous performance

-Planning should be fast, practical, and execution-focused.



Content Style (Critical):

This audience responds to:

-Relatable, experience-based content

-Lifestyle and wellness storytelling

-Honest, non-salesy delivery

-You should sound like a real person sharing what worked—not a brand or a salesperson.



Content Approach:

You will:

-Use provided hooks and frameworks

-Add your own voice and variations

-Continuously test and improve performance



Compensation:

Base: $200–$300/month (starting)

Commission Structure:

$10 per sale

+$5 for each rebill (up to 2 rebills per order)

???? Total potential:

Up to $20 commission per sale

Tiered incentives for higher performance



Requirements:

-Must have existing social media accounts on TikTok, X 
), Instagram, or
 that you can use for organic posting

-Must be able to create and post content targeting the US market

-Comfortable creating content (on-camera or written)

-Able to execute quickly and consistently

-Can follow direction AND contribute ideas

-Organized enough to plan weekly content



You Might Be a Fit If:

-You’ve created content on TikTok or similar platforms

-You understand what gets attention and engagement

-You can take a script and make it feel natural

-You are proactive and performance-driven



You’re NOT a Fit If:

-You over-plan instead of executing

-You focus on aesthetics over results

-You move slowly or need constant direction

-You’re looking for a passive or low-output role



Paid Trial Process (1 Week):

-All candidates will go through a 1-week paid trial.



During the trial, you will:

-Receive hooks, scripts, and direction

-Create daily content

-Submit a simple weekly content plan

-Test your own variations



Goal:

Generate at least 1 sale (ideal, not required)



We evaluate:

-Execution

-Content quality

-Consistency

-Initiative

-Top performers will be offered a long-term role.



Performance Assessment (Monthly):

All tea
mbers are evaluated on a monthly basis.



Assessment is based on:

-Content output and consistency

-Engagement and traffic generated

-Sales performance

-Initiative and ability to improve results



Quota & Expectations:

-This is a performance-based role with clear expectations.

-Each rep is expected to:

-Maintain consistent daily output

-Contribute to revenue generation

-Work toward monthly sales targets

-Specific quota benchmarks will be discussed during onboarding and adjusted based on performance and ramp period.

-Consistent underperformance may result in removal from the team.



To Apply:

Share links to your social media accounts



Answer this:

“If we gave you a hook, how would you turn it into multiple pieces of content AND what variation would you test to improve performance?”



Be specific. Generic answers will not be considered.



This is a performance-based role with real upside.

If you’re looking for a traditional job, this is not it.

If you want to execute, test, and get paid based on results—apply.

title: Senior EA / Operations VA for US Medical Consulting Firm — Policy Review, Notion, Long-Term
description:
I'm a physician and medical director based in Colorado, US. I own a single-physician PLLC that provides medical director services and NP/PA supervision to clinics across multiple US states (IV hydration, med spa, aesthetics, GLP-1, primary care).



I'm hiring one senior person to own the day-to-day operations so I can focus on the medical, compliance, and growth side of the business. This is a long-term, embedded role. If you're looking for a 3-month gig, this isn't it. If you're looking for a business owner you can grow with for years, we may be a good fit. 



What you'll own



Policy and SOP review. I have a library of clinic policies, standing orders, supervision agreements, and internal SOPs that support a multi-state practice. I will need you to review them, flag gaps, track versions, and propose edits. You don't need to be a lawyer or clinician, just be willing and able to look up normal policies and compare. 



Inbox monitoring and drafting. I get 30–60 inbound
s per day. Most are noise; a few are real new-client inquiries, state board notices, or NP/PA collaboration requests. You'll triage, draft responses in my voice for me to approve, and surface what actually needs my attention.



Calendar and scheduling. Managing my availability across consults, clinic onboardings, and personal time.



Occasional client text messages. Same voice-matching skill as
, lower volume.



Client and CRM organization. Keeping records of every clinic, NP, and PA I work with — contract status, state, audit cadence, supervision agreement renewal dates. - This will likely be an automated process we will be building around. I am hiring a contractor to build us a program from the ground up. 



Google Drive cleanup and ongoing structure. 1.5 years of accumulated documents across multiple state PLLCs need a clean folder taxonomy with naming conventions and version control.



Filtering inbound offers. New clinic inquiries, NP/PA collaboration requests, vendor pitches, and partnership offers come in regularly. You'll triage these against a checklist I'll teach you, surface the real opportunities, and bring the ones with potential to my attention. 



Eventually: light QuickBooks Online work — basic AP/AR and invoicing for the PLLC. Training provided if you don't have QBO experience but understand bookkeeping fundamentals.



Tools we use



Notion (primary source of truth — must have hands-on experience, not just exposure)



Zapier (current automations; willing to train someone strong who hasn't used it yet)



Google Workspace (Gmail, Drive, Calendar, Docs, Sheets)



Microsoft (Outlook, Calendar)



QuickBooks Online (training provided)



ChatGPT, Claude, and Perplexity (AI assistance is encouraged, not banned)



What I am looking for: 



2+ years of real EA or operations VA experience supporting US-based founders, executives, or business owners



Strong written English — you'll be drafting in my voice and writing to physicians, attorneys, and clinic owners



Comfortable in healthcare-adjacent work (HIPAA awareness expected; clinical background not required but a plus)



Proactive — you flag issues early and propose solutions, you don't wait to be asked



Organized to the point of being a little annoying about it (this is a compliment)



Discreet — you'll see sensitive business and patient-adjacent information



Available long-term, full-time, with at least some overlap with US business hours preferred



Who you are not



Looking for project-based or short-term work



A pure social media manager, content creator, or copywriter (those skills are nice but not the job)



Hoping to grow into a clinical role (this is admin-first and will stay that way)



A generalist who'll need everything explained from scratch — I want someone who walks in with judgment



How to apply



Send me a message that includes all four of the following. Applications that skip any of these will not be reviewed:



Briefly tell me about yourself - not a resume dump, just who you are and why this role caught your eye.



In your own words, what's the difference between a policy and an SOP? Two or three sentences max. There's no trick - I want to see how you think about documentation.



Walk me through how you'd approach the first 30 days of inbox triage for someone like me, assuming you have access to my inbox and a brief intro to my business. What would you set up first?



One question you have for me. Anyone who asks zero questions about the role isn't curious enough for this hire.



I will read every application that follows these instructions, and I'll respond within 3 business days to candidates who I think would be a good match. 



Looking forward to hearing from you.

Thomas

title: Brand Content Designer— Pet Lifestyle Brands (Canva + Notion, $550/mo, Work On Your Own Time)
description:
We're a multi-brand pet lifestyle business in the US (Chic Kitty, Shaggy Chic, Hugo the Minskin, and ambassador brands). We're hiring a Brand Content Producer to compile our weekly content across four brand identities.



You'll never touch our social media platforms or post anything live. You are the COMPILER. Our Operations Manager (OBM) provides you with the weekly content calendar, including exact specs. Our editor delivers video clips. Our graphic designer builds the master Canva templates. You pull the right pieces together, drop them into templates, package each piece according to our Notion naming conventions, and hand them off to the OBM for approval.



The work is precise, repeatable, and high-volume. If you love systems, follow strict guidelines exactly, and take pride in clean handoffs — this is your role.



WORK ON YOUR OWN TIME



This is a results-based role. We don't track when you work — we track what you deliver and whether it's on time, every time.



If you're a student, knock it out on your day off. If you have another job, do a little each day. If you're a night owl, work overnight. We don't care when the hours happen as long as:



- Weekly deliverables are complete on schedule (we give you the calendar a week in advance)

- The work is consistently on-brand and on-spec



Roughly 20 hours of work per week. Could be five 4-hour blocks. Could be two 10-hour sprints. Your call.



RESPONSE TIME



You'll work directly with our OBM (also Philippines-based, in the same time zone). Respond to OB
ssages in a timely manner — never longer than 12 hours on business days. Quick communication keeps the team's calendar moving.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



Every week, the OBM gives you a content calendar with exact specs for each piece. Your job is to:



- Assemble carousels in Canva using designer-built templates (3-5 per brand per week)

- Build Story sets with a minimum of 3-7 photos per set (templates pre-built by designer; you fill, label, and package)

- Convert Reels into Pinterest video pins (no re-editing, just package and label)

- Convert blog content into Pinterest idea pins (5-10 pages each)

- Convert blogs into Instagram carousels (each slide a stand-alone reference card)

- Cross-format content for different platforms (one piece often becomes 5-9 derivatives)

- Pull video clips from our raw footage Drive folder per the weekly specs

- Curate UGC and photo banks — sort approved submissions into the right brand folders

- Package each finished piece in Notion with strict naming conventions (we'll train you)

- Hand off to OBM for approval through Notion + WhatsApp

- Use our content banks and per-platform checklists each week

- Follow the weekly calendar exactly — no improvisation, no scope creep



PLATFORMS YOU'LL WORK IN



- Canva Pro (we provide access)

- Notion (we provide access — our Notion Architect will train you on our system)

- Google Drive (we provide access)



You will NOT log into any of our brand social media accounts (Instagram,
, Pinterest, TikTok). All posting is handled by a separate team.



WHAT YOU WON'T DO



- D
 what content gets made (OBM owns the calendar)

- Write captions, hashtags, or first-comments (OBM owns those banks)

- Edit video (editor owns that)

- Design templates from scratch (graphic designer builds masters; you swap content into them)

- Post anything to any platform (engagement team does posting)

- Engage with audience (engagement team does that)



REQUIREMENTS



- Strong Canva Pro skills — must be an expert with smart frames, hide/show toggles, brand template systems

- Fluent English (written) — must communicate clearly with US-based owner and Filipino OBM

- Strong eye for visual consistency — when given five brand systems with five distinct palettes, you respect each one and never mix them

- Detail discipline — naming conventions, folder structure, version control all matter

- Notion experience preferred (we'll train if not, but you must learn fast)

- Reliable internet

- Self-disciplined — flexibility only works if you deliver every time



OUR BRAND DNA — STRICT GUIDELINES YOU FOLLOW



We are a 100% AI-free brand. We do not use ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Midjourney, or any AI tool to create or assemble content. Every image and video is human-sourced and human-assembled. This is a firm policy — confirm in your application that you can work without AI tools.



We treat our animals like people. Never "the cat" or "the dog" — always by name (Hugo, Selina) or pronoun (she, he). Voice rule is locked across every brand.



Type lives in panels, never overlays photos. The animal is always 70-80% of the frame. Restraint signals confidence (our reference brands are The Row, Aesop, Kinfolk, Jacquemus, Bottega Veneta).



COMPENSATION



- $550 USD / month flat

- Roughly 20 hours / week (your schedule, your pacing)

- Paid biweekly via Wise, Remitly, or PayPal (your choice)

- Long-term role with growth potential as our brand portfolio expands



APPLICATION — REQUIRED



Please include:

1. Brief intro (3-5 sentences) — who you are, where you're based, your work setup, what else is on your plate (school, another job, etc. — that's fine, we want to know)

2. Link to portfolio or 3 examples of brand-template assembly work you've done (Canva carousels, social media graphics, brand kits)

3. Confirmation that you currently work AI-free, or that you commit to working AI-free in this role

4. Have you used Notion before? Brief description of how

5. Tell us how you'd structure roughly 20 hours per week across a real week of your life

6. Your favorite reference brand from this list: The Row, Aesop, Kinfolk, Jacquemus, Bottega Veneta — and one sentence on why



We respond to qualified applicants within 7 days. Top candidates receive a paid test ($40 USD) before the final hiring decision.

title: AI Developer
description:

If you light up when you talk about wiring agents together, shipping internal tools fast, and using AI as a daily working partner, and you'd rather drive the build strategy than wait for a spec, we'd love to hear from you.



The Role



This is a gig-based, project-driven build role focused on internal tooling. Here's what you'd actually be doing:



- Building agents and automations from the ground up, including wiring up MCP servers and Claude Code workflows

- Building a range of internal tools for the team, the kind of things that remove manual work and speed up how we operate

- Working across APIs and integrations, including GoHighLevel, to connect the systems we run on

- Partnering with the team on what gets built and why. We work as a team to win, and you'd own the technical thinking on your side of it



Within the first 30 to 60 days, success looks like you showing up with the plan. You should be telling us what we should build next, how to approach it, and in what order. You should have a clear point of view on what's worth automating, what isn't, and what you want to ship first. The bar here is strategic ownership of the build, not waiting for a backlog to be handed to you.



Schedule



Work hours are flexible but need to overlap with our team between 9:00 AM and 5:00 PM EST during active project work. Just want to make sure you can meet inside that window.



What We're Looking For



- An AI-first mindset. You use AI as a real working partner every day, and it shows in how you work.

- Independent problem-solving. You think first, use AI to amplify your thinking, and verify before shipping anything.

- A strategy-first approach. You're someone who shows up with the plan and tells us what we should be building, testing, and improving. You partner with our team on execution, but you lead the thinking on your work.

- Deep comfort with Claude Code, GitHub, Supabase, Vercel, working with APIs, and the GoHighLevel API. We're also genuinely interested in whatever else you've built your workflow around.

- A real love for this work. That comes through fast in conversation, and we'd rather hire someone who has it than someone who's just qualified.



How to Apply



A few things we'd love you to do, in order:



1. Please start your reply with the word "Jamal." We use this as a small check to spot applicants who read instructions carefully. Without it, we won't be able to review your application.



2. Record a 5-minute video answering the questions below. No script needed. We just want to get a feel for how you think.



3. Share your full tool stack with self-ratings (1 to 10). These ones we already know we need:

   - Claude Code    /10

   - GitHub    /10

   - Supabase    /10

   - Vercel    /10

   - Working with APIs    /10

   - GoHighLevel API    /10



   Then add every other tool you use, one per line, with /10. Include AI tools, frameworks, automation platforms, niche services, spreadsheets you've built, the works. Honesty matters more than scoring high. The video will give us a sense of where you actually are.



4. Walk us through your work history. For your last 2 or 3 clients or accounts:

   - What size was the company or account when you started (team size, what they were running, what was manual before you came in, whatever metric fits)?

   - What did you build for them?

   - What was the outcome? Where were they when you started, and where are they now?

   - If you have current clients, where are those projects today?



   We're trying to understand how you measure your own impact. The more specific, the better.



5. Quick confirmation that you can work somewhere inside the hours described above.



How You Use AI



In your video, spend a minute or so on this. The more specific the better:



- Which AI tools you use daily, weekly, and occasionally

- A specific example of a build task in this role where AI saves you real time, and how you use it

- A time AI gave you a wrong or bad output. How you caught it, and what you did about it

- Anything you've intentionally chosen NOT to let AI do in your work, and why



We're looking for real, lived examples. The specifics tell the story.



A Few Questions for Your Video



Take these in order, and just talk through them naturally.



1. If you came on next week and we asked you to build out our internal tooling, walk us through your first 30 days. What would you want to look at, what would you build first, and how would you d
 the order?

2. We hand you a vague request like "we need something to make X less painful," with no spec. Walk us through how you go from that sentence to a shipped tool.

3. An automation you built has started silently failing in production. Walk us through what you check first and how you track it down.

4. Why do you love building this kind of thing? Tell us about a recent tool or automation you shipped that reminded you why you do this work.

5. What's something about building with Claude Code, MCP, or agentic workflows that's changed in the last year that you've actually adjusted your approach around?

title: Online Math/Science Teacher(Near-Native Accent)
description:
About Pomelo Academy

Pomelo Academy is an innovative online international school dedicated to delivering high-quality education to students worldwide. We provide a dynamic and engaging learning environment, catering to individualized instruction that transcends geographical boundaries.



Job Description

We are seeking passionate and experienced Near-Native English-speaking Online K-12 Math and/or Science Teachers with verifiable teaching certifications. The ideal candidates will have strong academic backgrounds in Mathematics and/or Science, experience teaching young learners (ages 5–18), and a commitment to creating a supportive, inquiry-based, and engaging online learning environment.

Teach using internationally recognized curricula such as A Closer Look, Glencoe Science, Pearson Interactive Science, NGSS-aligned resources, Singapore Math, or IB/AP/A Level Math programs.

Near-native English accent with excellent spoken and written communication skills.

Strong academic background in Mathematics and/or Science (Biology, Physics, Chemistry, General Science).

Experience teaching in public/international schools or reputable online platforms.

Familiarity with inquiry-based and/or interdisciplinary approaches (e.g., STEM/STEAM).

Comfortable working between 07:00–22:00 (Weekdays) and 9:00–22:00 (Weekends), GMT+8.

Proficiency with digital platforms such as ClassIn, Microsoft Office, and other educational technologies.

Must have a stable and fast internet connection and a PC/laptop with at least Windows 10 or Mac OS Catalina.



Benefits

Access to training and professional development.

Regular enrollment model (not a booking system), ensuring schedule stability and consistency

title: Amazon Ads & Marketplace Growth Specialist
description:
About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Amazon Ads & Marketplace Growth Specialist to help manage, optimise and grow Amazon performance for consumer product brands.

This role is suited to someone who understands Amazon as more than an advertising platform. We need someone who knows how Amazon works as a marketplace, sales channel, product testing environment, brand protection tool and retail growth accelerator.

The right person will be confident working across Amazon Ads, Seller Central, Vendor Central, product listings, Amazon storefronts, Shopify connections, marketplace connectors, pricing control, product testing and campaign reporting.

This is not a basic “set up campaigns and leave them running” role. We need someone who can think strategically, commercially and technically to help brands achieve profitable growth on Amazon.



Role Overview

You will help plan, launch, manage and optimise Amazon advertising campaigns while also supporting the marketplace strategy behind those campaigns.

This includes understanding which products should be promoted on Amazon, how Amazon should work alongside Shopify or other eCommerce channels, how to avoid channel cannibalisation, and how to improve product visibility, pricing integrity and conversion performance.

The ideal candidate will be able to look at an Amazon account and identify:

Which campaigns are wasting spend

Which products have the best growth potential

Which listings need to be improved before scaling ads

Whether Vendor Central, Seller Central or a hybrid model is best suited

How Amazon can be used to test products before broader retail expansion

What return is required before increasing the ad budget



Key Responsibilities

Amazon Advertising

You will be responsible for planning, building, managing and optimising Amazon Ads campaigns, including:

Sponsored Products

Sponsored Brands

Sponsored Brands Video

Sponsored Display

Keyword targeting campaigns

Product targeting campaigns

Defensive brand campaigns

Competitor targeting campaigns

Category campaigns

Seasonal and promotional campaigns

You will manage campaign structure, keyword strategy, bids, budgets, placement performance, search terms, product targeting and ongoing optimisation.



Marketplace Strategy

You will help shape Amazon growth strategies that support each brand’s wider sales and eCommerce model.

This may include advising on:

Amazon vs Shopify product separation

Product testing strategies

Channel segmentation

Retail, Amazon and direct-to-consumer product allocation

Seller Central vs Vendor Central suitability

Hybrid marketplace models

Marketplace connector setup

Pricing and brand positioning

Amazon’s role in future retail demand generation

We need someone who can understand the commercial impact of Amazon, not just the advertising dashboard.



Seller Central, Vendor Central & Hybrid Models

The ideal candidate should have strong working knowledge of Amazon Seller Central and Vendor Central.

You should understand the practical differences between:

Selling directly to Amazon through Vendor Central

Selling through Seller Central

Using Seller Central for product testing and pricing control

Using Vendor Central for established products

Building a hybrid Amazon model

Transitioning products from Shopify testing to Seller Central and then Vendor Central

Using marketplace connectors to control listings, pricing and fulfilment

Experience with Shopify-to-Amazon workflows, marketplace connectors or multi-channel listing tools will be highly valued.



Product Listing & Marketplace Optimisation

You will review and improve Amazon product listings to support stronger conversion rates and better campaign performance.

This may include:

Product titles

Bullet points

Product descriptions

A+ Content

Amazon storefront structure

Product image recommendations

Keyword optimisation

Product positioning

Review and rating considerations

Listing consistency across marketplaces

Product catalogue troubleshooting

You should also be able to identify listing issues that may affect performance, including incorrect images, poor product data, weak product detail pages, incorrect brand links, duplicate listings, UPC/GTIN conflicts or storefront connection problems.



Brand Protection & Pricing Integrity

This role requires someone who understands the importance of brand control on Amazon.

You may need to help identify and resolve issues such as:

Amazon undercutting recommended pricing

Product ranges damaging brand positioning

Incorrect product information being pulled from other listings or marketplaces

Distributors or third parties affecting catalogue control

Products linking to the wrong storefront

Inconsistent pricing across Amazon, Shopify and retail

Poorly managed legacy SKUs affecting brand perception

You should be comfortable making practical recommendations about whether products should be retained, removed, repositioned, relisted or shifted between Seller Central and Vendor Central.



Product Testing & Campaign Scaling

A key part of this role is helping brands test Amazon as a growth channel before scaling investment.

You should be able to:

Recommend which SKUs to test first

Build a structured Amazon Ads testing plan

Allocate initial campaign budgets effectively

Track early performance clearly

Identify winning products and campaigns

Recommend when to scale spend

Explain when a product is not ready for advertising

Connect Amazon performance with broader eCommerce and retail goals

You should be comfortable working with initial test budgets and proving whether Amazon can become a scalable channel.



Reporting & Commercial Insights

You will prepare clear, practical reporting that helps clients understand performance and make better decisions.

Reporting may include:

Spend

Sales

ACOS

TACOS

ROAS

CPC

CTR

Conversion rate

Keyword performance

Search term performance

Product-level performance

Budget recommendations

Listing improvement recommendations

Next-step testing priorities

Reports should be simple enough for management teams to understand, while still detailed enough to support proper campaign optimisation.



Required Skills & Experience

The ideal candidate will have proven hands-on experience in:

Amazon Ads campaign management

Amazon Seller Central

Amazon Vendor Central

Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands and Sponsored Display

Amazon keyword research

Product targeting and competitor targeting

ACOS, TACOS, ROAS and conversion rate optimisation

Product listing optimisation

Amazon campaign reporting

Marketplace strategy for consumer products

Product launch or product testing campaigns

Amazon storefronts and A+ Content

Troubleshooting listing or catalogue issues

Working with multiple SKUs and product ranges

eCommerce performance marketing



Highly Valued Experience

Experience in any of the following would be a strong advantage:

FMCG, grocery, beverage, food, health, wellness, lifestyle or premium consumer products

Amazon Australia

Brands selling through both Amazon and Shopify

Marketplace connectors such as Codisto, Marketplace Connect or similar

Shopify and Amazon integration

Amazon Brand Registry

UPC, GTIN or catalogue ownership issues

Vendor Central pricing limitations

Seller Central pricing control

FBA, FBM and fulfilment workflows

Seasonal campaigns, product launches and promotional campaigns

Scaling Amazon campaigns from test budget to larger monthly spend

Using Amazon to support wider retail demand or product validation



Tools Experience

Experience with any of the following tools would be useful:

Amazon Ads Console

Seller Central

Vendor Central

Amazon Brand Registry

Amazon Brand Stores

Shopify

Marketplace Connect

Codisto

Helium 10

DataDive

Scale Insights

MerchantSpring

Jungle Scout

DataHawk

Pacvue

Perpetua

Google Analytics

Looker Studio

Meta Ads reporting

Google Ads reporting

ChatGPT or Gemini for research and reporting workflows



What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means:

Amazon campaigns are structured properly and actively optimised

Ad spend is being used efficiently

ACOS, TACOS, ROAS and profitability are clearly managed

Product listings are improved before spend is scaled

Amazon becomes a stronger sales and testing channel

Seller Central, Vendor Central and Shopify are working together strategically

Pricing, listing and storefront issues are identified and addressed

Clients understand what is working, what is not, and what should happen next

The business is seen as a credible Amazon growth partner



Who This Role Suits

This role would suit someone who is:

A hands-on Amazon Ads specialist

Strong across Amazon marketplace operations

Commercially minded and return-focused

Comfortable advising on product and channel strategy

Strong with numbers, testing and reporting

Able to explain Amazon performance in plain English

Confident working across ads, listings, pricing and marketplace setup

Proactive in identifying issues and opportunities

Experienced with consumer product brands

Focused on profitable growth, not just traffic or impressions



Application Requirements

Please apply with your CV and a short summary of your Amazon experience.

In your application, please include:

Amazon marketplaces you have worked across

Product categories you have managed

Monthly ad budgets you have worked with

Examples of ROAS, ACOS, TACOS or sales improvements

Your experience with Seller Central

Your experience with Vendor Central

Any Shopify or marketplace connector experience

Examples of listing, catalogue, Brand Registry or pricing issues you have helped resolve

Experience with FMCG, beverage, grocery, food, wellness, health, lifestyle or premium consumer brands

Tools you are confident using



Suggested Job Title

Amazon Ads & Marketplace Growth Specialist

Alternative titles:

Senior Amazon PPC Specialist

Amazon Marketplace Specialist

Amazon PPC & Seller Central Specialist

Amazon Growth Strategist

Amazon Performance Marketing Specialist

Amazon Seller Central & Vendor Central Specialist

Recommended title:

Amazon Ads & Marketplace Growth Specialist

How to Apply



Please submit:



your CV / resume

a cover letter including:

your current employment status

your availability to start

why you want to join the team

why you believe you are a strong fit for this role

your experience with Australian surveying workflows or companies, if applicable

Before We Proceed



Before we potentially proceed to the interview stage, we’d like to gather a few details to make sure the role is a good fit and that you’ll be set up for success working remotely with our team.



1) PC / Laptop specifications + internet speed

Please share your device specs, including CPU, RAM, and storage, along with a recent internet speed test result. We need reliable performance and strong internet to support day-to-day work.



2) Current employment or side work (transparency request)

Are you currently employed or doing any side jobs or freelance work? We’re open to offshore tea
mbers having multiple jobs — what matters most to us is transparency, so we understand your typical schedule and can support you properly.



3) Hubstaff tracker

Are you comfortable using Hubstaff time tracking? Our whole team operates remotely, including our field and admin staff in Australia. Hubstaff helps us understand time allocation across projects, improve internal reporting, and provide clearer updates to clients.



4) Working hours / availability

Can you commit to the required hours? Our standard workdays are Monday to Friday, generally within 9:00am–5:00pm (Philippines time). We offer reasonable flexibility — family and life come first — but we do need consistency and clear communication.



5) Expected salary (PHP)

If this differs from what was listed in the advert, please confirm your expected salary in PHP.



6) CV / Resume

Please attach your CV if you haven’t already.



7) Relevant training / courses

Please include any relevant training certificates or courses you’ve completed.



8) English level

Please confirm your English level (C1/C2) and your confidence in both written and spoken English.



Team Context



For context, we currently have a team of 10 people in the Philippines, all working from home, and we’re continuing to grow. We value honesty, transparency, and teamwork. We’re looking for people who are humble, reliable, and easy to work with — because every role matters, and the most important thing is a happy team doing work they enjoy, surrounded by like-minded people.



Thanks, and we look forward to your reply.

title: PM Appointment Setter & GoHighLevel CRM Coordinator — US Home Improvement (Part-Time, Remote, Daytime Shift)
description:
You are the voice that catches US homeowners in the prime evening window — when both spouses are home from work and ready to commit to home improvement projects. You call new Meta Ads leads within 5 minutes, qualify the project, and book in-home estimates for our sales reps. The PM shift converts the highest because both decision-makers are reachable. You live inside GoHighLevel and own every evening lead.

This is a phone-first role. If you do not like talking on the phone to strangers in English for 5 hours straight, do not apply.



What You Will Do Daily



Pick up the lead handoff from the AM setter at shift start

Call, SMS, and
 new Meta Ads leads within 5 minutes of submission

Qualify each lead using set scripts: project type, timeline, budget, decision-maker, homeowner status

Book confirmed appointments on the sales rep's calendar in GoHighLevel

Re-engage all leads who didn't answer during the AM shift — evenings are when they pick up

Log every touchpoint in GHL with detailed notes

Flag junk or fraudulent leads back to the ads team

Confirm next-day appointments with homeowners

Have spoken on the phone with US customers — chat-only and
-only experience does not qualify

Hands-on GoHighLevel experience: pipelines, workflows, SMS/email automations, calendars, tags, custom fields

Neutral, clear English. Confident phone presence. No heavy accent.

25+ Mbps wired internet, backup internet connection (mobile hotspot acceptable), noise-canceling headset, UPS or backup power, quiet dedicated workspace with door

Available 6:00 AM – 11:00 AM PHT every Monday through Saturday, on time

Cannot be working another full-time job simultaneously



Bonus Points



Home improvement, contractor, roofing, solar, HVAC, windows, kitchen/bath, or remodeling experience

Built GoHighLevel workflows and snapshots from scratch

Handled Meta/Facebook ad leads before — you know they're mostly tire-kickers and you still convert

Familiar with US homeowner objections and soft-sales techniques





Compensation Structure

Base salary:



Months 1–3: $400 USD/month

Month 4 onward (after passing 90-day trial): $500 USD/month

Paid weekly every Friday in USD via Wise or PayPal



Performance bonuses (paid monthly):



$4 USD per qualified appointment set (booked + confirmed on rep's calendar)

$6 USD per appointment that shows (homeowner sits with sales rep)

$35 USD per appointment that closes into a signed contract



Additional benefits:



13th month pay (one additional half-month of base, paid December 15)

5 paid days off per year after 90-day trial period

$75 one-time equipment stipend after passing 30-day trial

Base salary reviewed annually after the 90-day bump

Performance-based raises up to 15% per review



Realistic earning potential (after 90 days):



Average performer: ~$1,100/month

Top performer: ~$1,500/month



PM shift earns more in bonuses due to higher evening conversion rates.

Clawback clause: Invalid appointments (wrong number, not homeowner, no-show without confirmation, under-budget) reverse the bonus in the next pay cycle. Full definition of "qualified appointment" is in the offer letter.

Status: Independent contractor. You handle your own BIR taxes. Annual earnings statement provided.



Success Metrics You Will Be Measured On

- Help maintain a luxury-level client experience from inquiry to event day



Must-Have Requirements

- Excellent spoken and written English

- Confident speaking with US clients by phone

- Experience in customer success, sales, hospitality, events, weddings, travel, concierge service, or premium customer service

- Strong follow-up skills and comfort helping turn inquiries into bookings

- Ability to handle pricing questions professionally

- Very strong attention to detail with dates, times, payments, client requests, and event notes

- Reliable, proactive, and able to complete work without repeated reminders

- Comfortable with spreadsheets, admin work, and structured processes

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate has experience supporting premium clients and understands that tone, timing, accuracy, and follow-up matter.



You may be a strong fit if you:

-Can write polished and natural client messages

- Are comfortable with both sales follow-up and client support

- Can organize details without constant supervision

- Notice missing information before it creates a problem

- Know when to answer directly and when to escalate

- Stay calm and professional under pressure

- Want a long-term role with growth potential



Please Do Not Apply If

- You are looking for a basic VA/admin role only

- You are not comfortable speaking with clients by phone

- You need repeated reminders to complete tasks

- You are not detail-oriented with dates, times, payments, and client requests

- You are uncomfortable with sales follow-ups or pricing conversations

- You prefer step-by-step instructions for every small task

- You do not have reliable internet or a backup plan for remote work issues



Compensation

Starting at $6–$8/hour, depending on experience, phone confidence, sales ability, and relevant background.



This role starts at 20 hours/week, with potential to grow into 30–40 hours/week for the right person.



Performance bonuses and pay increases may be available after the probation period based on reliability, client communication, lead follow-up, booking support, attention to detail, and overall ownership.



We are looking for someone who can prove strong communication, judgment, reliability, and attention to detail before moving into a long-term role.

title: Video Editor & AI Content Specialist — Ecommerce Brand Remote · Full-time · Flexible Hours
description:
About the role

We're a fast-growing ecommerce brand looking for a sharp, creative video editor who doesn't just cut clips — they tell stories, speak multiple languages, and know how to use AI tools to work smarter. You'll be a core part of our content engine, producing polished product videos, ads, and multilingual content that converts across EU markets.

If you get excited about combining great storytelling with tools like ElevenLabs and Canva, know your way around a subtitle track, and can adapt content for French, German, Spanish, Dutch and beyond — we want to hear from you.



What you'll do



Edit compelling video content — product videos, ads, and reels — with a strong sense of pacing, story, and visual flow

Adapt and translate video content into multiple EU languages (FR, DE, ES, NL, IT and more), including flawless subtitle creation and voiceover coordination

Duplicate and repurpose creative assets — resizing, reformatting, and localising visuals across formats and platforms using tools like Canva

Use AI tools — especially ElevenLabs — to generate, clone, or translate voiceovers at scale without losing quality or brand voice

Produce perfectly timed, styled, and accurate subtitles that feel native to each language

Collaborate with our broader ecom team on campaigns, product launches, and ad testing





Skills we're looking for



Solid video editing skills in Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut, or similar — you understand why a cut works, not just how

Hands-on experience with Canva for asset creation, resizing, and localisation of visual content

Proficiency with ElevenLabs or similar AI voice tools to produce natural-sounding multilingual voiceovers

Experience with AI tools broadly — ChatGPT, Runway, Midjourney, or whatever helps you work faster and smarter

Ability to write or review subtitles in at least 2 EU languages, with attention to timing, line breaks, and readability

Strong asset adaptation skills — taking one piece of content and spinning it across multiple languages, formats, and platforms

An ecommerce mindset — you know what converts and edit with that goal in mind

Comfortable with fast turnarounds and working independently within a remote team





What we offer



Competitive salary based on experience

Fully flexible working hours — work when you're at your best

Remote-first setup

Real room to grow within a full ecommerce team

Access to the latest AI tools and subscriptions

Creative freedom and direct input on the content direction





How to apply

Send us your portfolio or showreel, a short intro about yourself, and examples of any multilingual or AI-assisted content you've created. Ecommerce experience is a big plus.

One small thing — to show us you've read this properly, please mention your favourite type of sausage somewhere in your application. It's our little filter. No sausage, no reply.

title: Recruiter - $3-4/hr Base + $10 Bonus Per Sale From Your Recruits (Uncapped)
description:
We're hiring a Recruiter who wants to earn more than their hourly rate. Your base is $3–$4/hr, but the real money is the bonus: you earn $10 every time an appointment setter you recruited closes a sale. No cap. No expiration. As long as your recruits keep producing, you keep getting paid.



  This is built for someone with drive. If you want a flat paycheck and a checklist, this is not for you. If you want to build a team

   that pays you every day, keep reading.



  What you'll do



  - Source experienced PH-based appointment setters / outbound dialers from OnlineJobs.ph,
 groups, Reddit, LinkedIn, and your own network

  - Screen applicants by phone - voice quality, English fluency, dialer experience, work ethic, internet/power backup setup

  - Run a short paid trial / mock call with shortlisted candidates and recommend the best to us for hire

  - Stay in touch with the setters you placed - their performance is your bonus. Coach them, encourage them, alert us if one is

  slipping so we can save them before they quit

  - Keep your pipeline full so we always have 2-3 vetted setters ready to onboard



  Compensation



  - Base: $3-$4/hr (depending on experience), paid weekly via OnlineJobs.ph EasyPay

  - Bonus: $10 per closed sale from any setter you sourced. Paid weekly alongside base. Bonus continues for as long as that setter is active with us - no cutoff.

  - Realistic example: A team of 5 productive setters closing 1 sale per day each = ~100 sales/month = $1,000/month bonus on top of your hourly. Your job is to build and keep that team.



  Schedule



  - Full-time, 40 hrs/week

  - US business hours (approximately 9 PM - 6 AM Manila time, Monday–Friday)

  - This overlap matters - you'll be screening setters who work the same shift



  What we need from you



  - 1+ year recruiting / HR / talent sourcing experience (BPO or VA agency background a big plus)

  - Strong spoken and written English - you'll be on screening calls daily

  - A track record of placing people who actually stayed and produced (we will ask for specifics)

  - Reliable laptop, fiber internet, backup power, quiet workspace

  - A genuinely competitive personality. You should care that your recruits perform, because your income depends on it.



  About us



  We run multi-vertical outbound campaigns (insurance, home services, B2B) on a modern dialer/CRM platform. Our setters get clean lists, real training, and weekly pay. Your job is to find us more of them.



  How to apply



  1. Subject line: include the word "DRIVE" so we know you read this post. Applications without it are deleted unread.

  2. In your application, tell us: the best recruit you ever placed, why they worked out, and how long they stayed.

  3. Attach a 60-second Loom or voice memo introducing yourself in English.

  4. Include your DISC profile if you have one.



  We respond to qualified applicants within 48 hours. Looking to hire this week.

• Knowledge of packaging and custo
rch production

Why Join Us?

title: Outbound Appointment Setter — Cold Calling & Lead Generation Specialist
description:
We’re hiring a confident, outcome-focused Virtual Assistant to run cold-calling outreach using our knowledge base. This is not a script-reader role — you’ll use structured content and product knowledge to engage prospects, qualify leads, and book qualified meetings. Quick thinking, clear communication, and disciplined note-taking into our knowledge base are essential.





What you’ll do

- Use our knowledge base and call scripts as a starting point — adapt language to each prospect naturally.

- Make outbound cold calls to prospects on supplied lists (phone + CRM).

- Qualify leads to a tight brief: needs, budget range, timeline, decision-makers, and next steps.

- Book discovery/demo calls directly on the calendar for our sales team.

- Log call outcomes, notes, and follow-up tasks in the knowledge base and CRM immediately after each call.

- Run follow-up calls and reminder sequences per playbook until prospect responds or is disqualified.

- Escalate complex or technical questions to the assigned SME and update the knowledge base with new FAQs or clarifications.

- Hit daily/weekly call and meeting targets and maintain call quality standards.

- Provide short weekly reports: calls made, contacts reached, qualified leads, common objections, and suggested knowledge-base updates.



Who we’re looking for

- Comfortable with cold calling and objection handling — you don’t hang up early.

- Strong verbal communication and fast thinker on the phone.

- Able to learn and reference a product/service knowledge base quickly and accurately.

- CRM-savvy (HubSpot, Pipedrive, Salesforce, or similar) and disciplined about logging data.

- Reliable, punctual, and professional on calls.

- Persistent but respectful — you push for outcomes without being spammy.

- Able to follow a playbook but adapt language to sound human and relevant.

- Comfortable with performance tracking and meeting weekly targets.



Tools & systems

- You’ll work from our shared knowledge base (structured articles, objection scripts, product sheets).

- CRM access for logging and call lists.

- Calendar tool for booking meetings.

- Must have a quiet workspace and reliable internet/phone setup.



Performance expectations

- Daily: X outbound calls (we’ll agree target), accurate CRM updates for each call.

- Weekly: Y qualified meetings booked (target set during onboarding).

- Quality: Clear call notes, correct qualification per our brief, and timely knowledge-base updates where needed.



What success looks like in 30/60/90 days

- 30 days: Confidently navigating the knowledge base, meeting call activity targets, regularly qualifying leads to brief.

- 60 days: Consistently hitting meeting-booking goals, reducing average time to qualify, contributing useful knowledge-base improvements.

- 90 days: Reliable pipeline contributor, few errors in CRM logging, proactive in proposing refinements to scripts and playbooks.



Apply only if you have real cold-calling experience and can demonstrate consistent results. In your application, answer briefly:

1. How many outbound cold calls did you make per day in your last role, and what meeting/qualified-lead rate did you achieve?

2. Describe how you would use a knowledge base during a call when a prospect asks a technical question you don’t know the answer to.

3. Give one short example of a time you turned a difficult objection into a booked meeting — what you said and what happened next.



To apply, include a short voice sample (1–2 minutes) of you making a prospecting call (real or role-played) and a brief note on which CRM you’ve used.

title: Video Editor
description:
Meta Ads Video Editor Wanted – E-Commerce | Long-Term Role

We run e-commerce brands across 4 international markets and we're scaling our paid social aggressively. We're looking for a high-output video editor to start with 2 of our markets — with a clear path to expand to all 4 markets (and higher pay) once you've proven your speed and quality.



Weekly Output Breakdown (Phase 1):



- 30–40 ads per week per market

- 2 markets to start

- Total: 60–80 ads per week (~260–340 ads/month)



Speed, attention to detail, and a deep understanding of what makes ads convert matter more than fancy VFX. This is a performance creative role, not a cinematic one.



The Opportunity



- Phase 1 (months 1–2): 30–40 ads/week per market × 2 markets = 60–80 ads/week total

- Phase 2 (month 3+): If you're crushing it, we expand to all 4 markets = 120–160 ads/week total with a meaningful pay raise

- Long-term: A stable, well-paid seat on a growing team — not a one-off gig



What You'll Be Doing



- Editing 30–40 Meta ads per week per market (60–80 ads/week total across 2 markets)

- Producing the same ad concept in 2 languages

- Swapping text overlays, captions, subtitles, and voiceovers for each language version

- Producing multiple variations per concept (different hooks, CTAs, intros, durations)

- Cutting UGC footage, stock clips, product shots, and screen recordings into scroll-stopping ads

- Formats: 9:16 (Reels/Stories), 1:1 (Feed), 4:5

- Adding captions, B-roll, text overlays, sound effects, music, and pattern interrupts

- Editing in the style of proven ad frameworks: Problem/Solution, Testimonial, Listicle, Before/After, Founder Story, Unboxing, "Did You Know", etc.

- Building reusable templates for efficient localization

- Organizing files by market/language so we can track performance per region

- Iterating fast based on ad performance feedback



Must-Haves



- 2+ years editing Meta/Facebook ads specifically (not just YouTube or weddings — paid social is its own craft)

- Proficient in at least one of: DaVinci Resolve, CapCut, Final Cut Pro, Premiere Pro

- Proven capacity to deliver 30–40 high-quality ads/week per market consistently

- Experience producing ads in multiple languages — you understand how text timing, line breaks, and subtitle pacing change when text length differs between languages

- Comfortable working with provided translations and voiceover files (we supply them — you don't need to speak the languages)

- Master of template-based workflows — you don't rebuild from scratch for every language version

- Extreme attention to detail with foreign-language text — no typos, no cut-off captions, no mismatched timing, even in languages you don't speak

- Deep understanding of the first 3 seconds — you know a weak hook when you see one

- Good English (written communication with our team)

- Reliable internet and a computer that handles HD editing smoothly



What We Offer



- Competitive monthly salary for Phase 1 (60–80 ads/week, 2 markets)

- Clear raise if/when we expand you to all 4 markets (120–160 ads/week)

- Performance reviews and raises every 6 months

- A clear brief for every ad with all assets (footage, translations, voiceovers) organized and ready

- Long-term, stable work — we're scaling, not testing the waters



How to Apply

To prove you actually read this (most applicants don't), please do the following:



1. Start your application with the word "Scroll-Stop" — applications without this will be ignored.

2. Send 3–5 examples of Meta ads you personally edited (Drive, YouTube, or Meta Ads Library links).

3. Have you produced ads in multiple languages before? If yes, which languages and how did you handle the workflow?

4. Be honest: can you realistically deliver 30–40 high-quality ads/week per market (60–80 total across 2 markets)? If your max is lower, tell me your actual sustainable number.

5. Tell me in 2–3 sentences: what makes a Meta ad hook work in the first 3 seconds?

6. Share your monthly rate and your main editing software.

7. Bonus: link to one e-commerce brand whose Meta ads you admire — and why.



Top candidates will get a paid test project (1 concept localized into 2 languages) within a week. The right person gets a long-term home with us.
